captions.facebook_feed:
RIVER BURSTS, SWEEPING CARS THROUGH THE STREETS

On October 19, 2026, the Girona River burst its banks after a historic downpour, sending floodwater through the streets of Els Poblets and El Verger and carrying away cars. Close to 500 mm of rain fell in the area from midnight, according to La Marina. Residents near the river were evacuated, and authorities said at least two people died in floods across eastern Spain.

📍 Els Poblets, Alicante, Spain
Never drive or walk into floodwater; just a few inches of moving water can sweep a car away. Move to higher ground and stay away from riverbanks.
Follow instructions from local authorities during an active emergency.

🎥 La Marina Plaza / residents of Els Poblets
Fact sources: La Marina (elDiario.es) — https://lamarina.eldiario.es/2026/10/19/una-historica-tromba-de-500-mm-desborda-el-rio-girona-y-convierte-las-calles-en-rios-con-coches-flotando-en-verger-y-els-poblets-y-aisla-pego/ ; The Local Spain — https://www.thelocal.es/20261019/latest-at-least-two-dead-as-floods-wreak-havoc-in-eastern-spain
